scientific_integrity: All-size proof supplied via interval-fiber bijection; exhaustive enumeration through n=9 is corroboration only. New claims are the common-product-rank generating function, structural side-exclusion criterion, and derived asymptotics. Known idempotent Fibonacci numbers and earlier endomorphism formulas are credited. No independent audit or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proven for full order-preserving total transformation monoids of finite chains only; no bivariate individual factor-rank refinement, general-poset analogue, or claim of exhaustive priority. Asymptotics for n tending to infinity. A closely related 2006 paper was accessible only by abstract; equivalent hidden prior work remains possible.
title: Product-rank renewal law for commuting monotone idempotents
